🛠️ **How to use it in a real system:** Attribute LCP to its resource and server path, INP to event and rendering work, and CLS to unsized or late content. Segment real-user data by page and device, then set regression budgets.

⚖️ **When to use it—and when not to:** State assumptions before choosing. Compare at least one credible alternative, describe overload and dependency failure, make permissions and data exposure explicit, and keep rollback possible.
